sloka: दत्त अभय वधो नाम पातकम् महत् अद्भुतम् ।अहम् च लक्ष्मणः च एव सीत च वरवर्णिनी ॥४-१२-३५॥
transliteration: datta abhaya vadho nāma pātakam mahat adbhutam ।aham ca lakṣmaṇaḥ ca eva sīta ca varavarṇinī ॥4-12-35॥

translations.english: 'It is said that killing a person to whom protection is promised is highly sinful. Lakshmana, darling Sita and me, are under your care and you are our refuge.
